event_loop_lag_p99_seconds.help: The event loop's delay at the 99th percentile over the last few seconds

pg_pool_idle.help: Connections a Postgres pool holds and nobody is using

pg_pool_waiting.help: Requests queued for a connection from a Postgres pool

pg_connection_headroom.help: Postgres connections left once every instance seen holds its full share; NaN before the first check

redis_reconnects_total.help: Attempts to reconnect a Redis connection, by what the connection is for

state_acks_missed_total.help: game:state sends a socket did not acknowledge in time

cluster_messages_total.help: Messages this instance put on Redis for other instances, by channel: the adapter's (bar its heartbeats) or an instance inbox

redis_stream_lag_seconds.help: How long the last entry read from a stream had waited in it; 0 once nothing has been read for 30 s

redis_stream_read_age_seconds.help: How long since an entry was last read from a stream: a stuck reader grows it, and so does a quiet stream

limiter_fallbacks_total.help: Requests a rate limiter counted only in this instance's memory because Redis did not answer

store_maxmemory_bytes.help: The key-value store's memory limit; 0 is none

store_evicted_keys.help: Keys the key-value store evicted since it started; any is state lost

store_blocked_clients.help: Connections waiting in a blocking read on the key-value store

store_rejected_connections.help: Connections the key-value store refused since it started

store_info.help: 1, labelled with the key-value store's engine, version and eviction policy from its last INFO

store_misconfigured_total.help: Checks that found the key-value store unlike deploy/runtime.json's, by what differed
